name: Form Builder
description: Form Builder is a platform designed for creating forms and surveys with ease and speed, similar to Google Forms. It offers users a variety of tools to create customized forms that meet their specific needs, whether for surveys, data collection, or questionnaires. Users can add different types of questions, such as short and long text responses, numerical answers, multiple-choice questions, and tables. Once the form is completed, it can be easily shared with others to collect responses and analyze the data effortlessly. The platform features a simple and user-friendly interface, ensuring a smooth and seamless experience for all users in creating and distributing forms.

name: Kimo Bot
description: Kimo Bot offers an engaging game with a three-reel slot machine and exciting missions to collect coins to advance through different levels. players can complete daily tasks and special missions to boost their earnings. The game offers a dynamic leaderboard, allowing you to compete with friends and other players globally.

name: Levant Light
description: Levant Light is a project developed to showcase a wide range of lamp products and their categories in a user-friendly manner. The Levant Light website features a clean, responsive design that effectively presents various lighting solutions. As the front-end developer, I ensured the platform offers seamless navigation, interactive elements, and an intuitive user experience. Additionally, the website is optimized for SEO, enhancing its visibility and ranking in search results.
